title: Automatic-Weir Event & Hydraulic-Control Readiness

forbidden_dependencies: direct THETA/THETAS/DZ traversal inside the control policy
immutable_period_parameters: explicit event schedule translated from management periods and INTWL
selected-head location metadata prepared outside the policy

target_selection.groundwater_filter: while groundwater_level > GWLCRIT[iphase] and iphase>1: iphase--
target_selection.air_volume_filter: while total_air_volume < VCRIT[iphase] and iphase>1: iphase--
target_selection.pressure_head_filter: while selected_pressure_head > HCRIT[iphase] and iphase>1: iphase--
target_selection.initialization: runtime must schedule an explicit initial control evaluation; tcum<1e-10 is not a kernel invariant

drop_rate.legacy_equation: if requested_target < old_WLSTAR and DROPR > 0.001 then trial_WLSTAR=max(requested_target,old_WLSTAR-DROPR*dt) else trial_WLSTAR=requested_target

event_translation.modern_rule: adapter/runtime translates management-period boundaries and recurring INTWL adjustment instants into explicit event times before kernel execution
event_translation.kernel_receives: is_adjustment_event plus active immutable management-period parameters for [t0,t1]
event_translation.event_inside_interval: subdivide interval; do not smear target selection across the event

control_state.transactional_requirement: trial WLSTAR must rollback exactly with rejected trials; D6 owns atomic commit

capacity_discrepancy.source_branch_test: if discap > wdis capacity is sufficient; equality falls to overflow
capacity_discrepancy.risk_current_WLS_below_crest: SWQHR1 base can be negative; fractional BETAW is outside real-valued power domain and integer/even powers can produce nonphysical positive capacity below crest
capacity_discrepancy.disposition: no automatic-weir capacity production formula is admitted by D5; require separate theory/source/scientific qualification of a versioned physical capacity-head policy
capacity_discrepancy.overflow_fallback: future runtime may use the D4-qualified consistent rating/balance route, but must not reproduce legacy inconsistent SWST/WLS bisection state

exit_criteria: prove phase-selection equation equivalence for valid ordered threshold tables
prove between-event WLSTAR persistence and explicit-event replacement of legacy day arithmetic
prove drop-rate trial evolution for arbitrary positive dt and exact rollback semantics at contract level
characterize SWQHR1/SWQHR2 capacity-head asymmetry and negative-WOVER domain without silently choosing a replacement formula
define clean scalar hydraulic-control view without HeadCalc internals
